title: Grade 5 French — Fri, May 22
description: Telling Time & Daily Routine (L'Heure et la Routine) — Last Week Day 5
subject: french

questions.question: How do you ask 'What time is it?' in French?
questions.explanation: 'Quelle heure est-il?' = 'What time is it?' You answer: 'Il est...' (It is...)

questions.question: How do you say 'It is 3 o'clock' in French?
questions.explanation: 'Il est trois heures' = 'It is 3 o'clock'. Always 'Il est' + number + 'heure(s)'.

questions.question: How do you say 'half past four' (4:30) in French?
options: Il est quatre heures et demie
Il est quatre heures et demi
questions.explanation: 'Il est quatre heures et demie' = 4:30. 'Et demie' = and a half (feminine because 'heure' is feminine).

questions.question: What does 'Il est midi' mean?
questions.explanation: 'Il est midi' = 'It is noon/midday' (12:00 PM). 'Il est minuit' = midnight (12:00 AM).

questions.question: How do you say 'quarter past 2' (2:15) in French?
options: Il est deux heures moins le quart
Il est deux heures et quart
Il est quart après deux heures
questions.explanation: 'Il est deux heures et quart' = 2:15. 'Et quart' = and a quarter.

questions.question: How do you say '10 to 5' (4:50) in French?
options: Il est cinq heures moins dix
questions.explanation: Both 'Il est cinq heures moins dix' (5 o'clock minus 10) and 'Il est quatre heures cinquante' (4:50) are correct.

questions.question: What does 'Je me lève' mean?
questions.explanation: 'Je me lève' = 'I get up'. It is a reflexive verb (se lever). 'Je me couche' = I go to bed.

questions.question: What is a 'verbe pronominal' (reflexive verb)?
options: A verb where the subject and object are the same person (e.g., I wash myself)
A verb used only in formal contexts
questions.explanation: Reflexive verbs describe actions done to oneself: se lever (to get up), se laver (to wash oneself), se coucher (to go to bed).

questions.question: How do you say 'I brush my teeth' in French?
questions.explanation: 'Je me brosse les dents' = 'I brush my teeth'. Reflexive verb: 'se brosser les dents'.

questions.question: What does 'Je prends le petit-déjeuner à sept heures' mean?
options: I go to school at 7 o'clock
questions.explanation: 'Je prends le petit-déjeuner à sept heures' = 'I have breakfast at 7 o'clock'. 'Petit-déjeuner' = breakfast.

questions.question: How do you say 'I go to bed at 9 PM' in French?
options: Je me lève à neuf heures du soir
Je me couche à neuf heures du soir
Je m'endors à neuf heures du soir
questions.explanation: 'Je me couche à neuf heures du soir' = 'I go to bed at 9 PM'. 'Du soir' = in the evening/PM.

questions.question: What does 'du matin' mean when telling time?
questions.explanation: 'Du matin' = in the morning (AM). 'Du soir' = in the evening (PM). 'De l'après-midi' = in the afternoon.

questions.question: How do you say 'I get dressed' in French?
questions.explanation: 'Je m'habille' = 'I get dressed'. From 's'habiller' (to get dressed). 'Je me lave' = I wash myself.

questions.question: What does 'le soir' mean?
questions.explanation: 'Le soir' = the evening. 'Le matin' = morning, 'L'après-midi' = afternoon, 'La nuit' = the night.

questions.question: Which sentence correctly describes a daily routine?
options: Je me lève à sept heures, puis je me couche
Je me couche à sept heures du matin, puis je prends le déjeuner
Je me lève à sept heures du matin, puis je prends le petit-déjeuner
Je me lève le soir et je me couche le matin
questions.explanation: 'Je me lève à sept heures du matin, puis je prends le petit-déjeuner' = I get up at 7 AM, then I have breakfast — a logical daily routine.
